Who works on what among the people who supervise, teach and examine in the Statistics curriculum. Keywords help students find possible supervisors and members of their committees. The official composition of the doctoral committee is on the [PhD programme website](https://www.dems.unimib.it/en/node/1047).

::: {.faculty data-csv="data/faculty.csv"}
[Download the list (CSV)](data/faculty.csv)
:::
